title: Default image builds cannot reach Forgejo from the build namespace
wanted_capability: The standard image-build workflow can fetch its pinned public repository ref from the configured Forgejo mirror.
missing_primitive: Compatible Forgejo ingress policy for the bbox-build namespace, or an explicitly supported public-origin build fallback.
fallback_used: Submitted the same build workflow with its existing git-url parameter pointing to the public GitHub origin, preserving the exact SHA check. No shared network policy changed.
evidence: build-bbox-image-8sb4t: build-in-clone git fetch failed with exit 128 before compilation against the default mirror address.
build-bbox-image-k4b2k: the same ref failed before compilation against the Forgejo cluster service address.
Read-only inspection of forge/estate-ingress-walls shows permitted namespaces do not include bbox-build. Forgejo pod and service endpoints are healthy; host-side ls-remote succeeds.
notes: Observed while preparing the native session browsing image on 2026-09-10. Any shared network policy repair requires operator approval; this task only uses the per-run public-origin parameter.
resolution_note: obsolete: the build namespace now reaches the Forgejo mirror through the default git-url (the VIP NodePort mirror address set in the cage build workflow templates). On 2026-09-24, bbox-verify and bbox-base-regen workflows in the same namespace, using the default git-url with a mandatory git fetch, succeeded repeatedly (for example bbox-verify-g24m2). build-bbox-image uses the identical default and fetch step. The build workflow and ingress policy are operator deployment infrastructure outside the blackbox repo, so any recurrence belongs to that infrastructure rather than a blackbox code issue.
